text: 2026年中国资本市场学术年会今天（11月14日）在上海开幕。第十二届全国政协副主席周小川出席并作开幕演讲。中国证监会主席、中国资本市场学会会长吴清，上海市市长朱忠明致辞。
text_en: The 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Conference opened today (November 14) in Shanghai. Zhou Xiaochuan, Vice Chairman of the 12th National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, attended and delivered the opening speech. CSRC Chairman and China Capital Market Society President Wu Qing and Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming delivered remarks.
